what: R0's preflight: what the runner under qualification is given and what it must do. The runner is the one R0 names; these states are synthetic and built fresh for each case.

interface.evaluator: gates/check-development-plan.py [plan] --run <run.json>: exit 0 when terminal claims hold, 2 when not yet, 1 when the run is invalid; the JSON body's eligible[mode] lists the nodes the runner may dispatch in that mode
interface.run_file: the shape the plan's evidence_contract.run_shape states
interface.packet: per dispatched node: run, node and attempt ids; plan, node, catalog and profile identity; accepted predecessor result digests; current subject fingerprints; the node's owned paths; mode and runner identity; required cases; done criteria

graph: the current plan's own nodes, with records built by the Fixture class of the regression suite the plan binds (plan.regression_tests) and marked SYNTHETIC-AUTHOR-REGRESSION-NOT-PRODUCT-EVIDENCE; the workers the runner dispatches are stubs that write only under their node's owned paths unless a case says otherwise

given: a run in which P00 and P01 are accepted and nothing else is recorded
the same run after P01's record is made stale by changing its node digest
a run whose M1 record failed, and one whose P02 record names another subject fingerprint
expect: the runner dispatches exactly eligible['coordinator'] and nothing else
none of P01's dependents is dispatched while its record is stale
no consumer of the failed or mis-subjected record is dispatched, and no terminal claim is reported

given: the runner is killed after writing in_flight {P02: attempt a1} and before recording a result
the runner is killed after integrating P02's delta and before recording it
expect: on restart the runner resumes or reconciles attempt a1 by that id and dispatches P02 under no other attempt id while a1 is unresolved
the integrated delta is reconciled against the tree, not applied a second time, and the earlier attempt's evidence is kept

given: a P02 stub that also writes under a path P03 owns
P02 and P03 stubs that both propose a change to one shared integrator path
a shared-path patch prepared against a base that has since moved
expect: the out-of-scope write is refused and the attempt is not recorded as passed
shared-path patches are applied by the integrator one at a time
the stale-base patch is refused, not merged

given: requested mode unattended with no R0 record
an R0 record whose runner fingerprint differs from the current runner's
an R0 record the runner produced in unattended mode
expect: nothing is dispatched unattended in any of the three, and eligible['unattended'] is empty
the runner records why it refused, and never qualifies itself by an unattended run
